UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user of the BioMedLink system, storing their profile information and role. Authentication details are managed externally.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

email.description: The user's email address, used for identification.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

role.description: The role of the user within the system, defining their access permissions. (e.g., Admin, Biomedical Engineer, Technician)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

Department.title: Department
Department.description: Represents a hospital department where equipment is located.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Department entity.

name.description: The official name of the hospital department (e.g., 'ICU', 'Radiology').

description.description: A brief description or purpose of the department.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the department record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the department record was last updated.

Equipment.title: Equipment
Equipment.description: Represents a piece of biomedical engineering equipment within a hospital department.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Equipment entity.

name.description: The common name of the equipment (e.g., 'MRI Scanner', 'Ventilator').

modelNumber.description: The model number of the equipment, used for specific identification.

serialNumber.description: The unique serial number of the equipment, crucial for identification and troubleshooting.

assetNumber.description: An internal hospital asset tracking number for the equipment. Can be null.

departmentId.description: Reference to the Department where the equipment is located. (Relationship: Department 1:N Equipment)

purchaseDate.description: The date when the equipment was purchased.

installationDate.description: The date when the equipment was installed.

warrantyExpiryDate.description: The date when the equipment's warranty expires.

status.description: The current operational status of the equipment (e.g., 'Operational', 'Under Maintenance', 'Out of Service', 'Retired').

lastServiceDate.description: The date of the most recent service performed on the equipment, updated automatically from maintenance logs.

nextServiceDate.description: The calculated date for the next scheduled service, updated automatically from maintenance logs.

manualUris.description: An array of URIs pointing to uploaded manuals or documentation for the equipment.

imageUris.description: An array of URIs pointing to images of the equipment.

qrCodeUri.description: URI to the generated QR code image for this equipment's profile.

barcodeValue.description: The barcode value associated with the equipment for quick scanning.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the equipment record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the equipment record was last updated.

MaintenanceLog.title: MaintenanceLog
MaintenanceLog.description: Records all maintenance activities, repairs, inspections, or installations performed on a piece of equipment.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MaintenanceLog entity.

equipmentId.description: Reference to the Equipment this log pertains to. (Relationship: Equipment 1:N MaintenanceLog)

performedById.description: Reference to the UserProfile of the engineer or technician who performed the maintenance. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N MaintenanceLog)

logType.description: The type of maintenance activity performed (e.g., 'Preventive Maintenance', 'Repair', 'Inspection', 'Installation').

serviceDate.description: The date and time when the service or maintenance was performed.

description.description: A detailed description of the work performed or issue addressed.

notes.description: Any additional notes or observations related to the maintenance.

faultDescription.description: Description of the fault if the log type is 'Repair'.

resolution.description: Description of how the fault was resolved if the log type is 'Repair'.

downtimeDurationMinutes.description: The duration of equipment downtime in minutes associated with this maintenance event.

replacedParts.description: An array of strings listing any parts that were replaced during this maintenance.

cost.description: The cost incurred for this maintenance activity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the maintenance log was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the maintenance log was last updated.

AITroubleshootingSession.title: AITroubleshootingSession
AITroubleshootingSession.description: Records an AI-powered troubleshooting session for a specific piece of equipment.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AITroubleshootingSession entity.

equipmentId.description: Reference to the Equipment being troubleshooted. (Relationship: Equipment 1:N AITroubleshootingSession)

engineerId.description: Reference to the UserProfile of the engineer initiating the session. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N AITroubleshootingSession)

startTime.description: The date and time when the troubleshooting session started.

endTime.description: The date and time when the troubleshooting session ended or was completed. Can be null if ongoing.

problemSummary.description: A summary of the problem or symptoms initially presented to the AI.

resolutionSummary.description: A summary of the resolution or guidance provided by the AI, if applicable. Can be null.

wasHelpful.description: User feedback indicating if the AI's assistance was helpful. Can be null.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the AI troubleshooting session record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the AI troubleshooting session record was last updated.

AITroubleshootingMessage.title: AITroubleshootingMessage
AITroubleshootingMessage.description: Stores individual messages within an AI troubleshooting session, representing the conversation flow.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AITroubleshootingMessage entity.

sessionId.description: Reference to the AITroubleshootingSession this message belongs to. (Relationship: AITroubleshootingSession 1:N AITroubleshootingMessage)

senderType.description: Indicates whether the message was sent by the 'User' or the 'AI'.

content.description: The actual text content of the message.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the message was sent.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the AI troubleshooting message record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the AI troubleshooting message record was last updated.

definition.description: Stores user profile details including `role` for role-based access control. Path-based ownership: `userId` must match `request.auth.uid`.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique ID of the user, matching `request.auth.uid`.

definition.description: Manages hospital departments. Accessible to all authenticated users for read, with Admin role for CRUD operations.

params.name: departmentId
params.description: The unique ID of the department.

definition.description: Stores detailed records of biomedical equipment. Includes `departmentId` for logical grouping and filtering. Access is role-based (Admin, Biomedical Engineer, Technician) and can be restricted by `departmentId` (checking `request.auth.uid`'s `managedDepartmentIds`).

params.name: equipmentId
params.description: The unique ID of the equipment.

definition.description: Records all maintenance activities for a specific piece of equipment. Includes denormalized `departmentId` (from parent `Equipment`) and `equipmentId` (from path) for authorization independence.

params.name: equipmentId
params.description: The unique ID of the parent equipment.

params.name: logId
params.description: The unique ID of the maintenance log entry.

definition.description: Stores AI troubleshooting sessions for specific equipment. Includes denormalized `departmentId` (from parent `Equipment`) and `equipmentId` (from path) for authorization independence.

params.name: equipmentId
params.description: The unique ID of the parent equipment.

params.name: sessionId
params.description: The unique ID of the AI troubleshooting session.

definition.description: Stores individual messages within an AI troubleshooting session. Includes denormalized `departmentId`, `equipmentId` (from parent `AITroubleshootingSession`), and `sessionId` (from path) for authorization independence.

params.name: equipmentId
params.description: The unique ID of the grandparent equipment.

params.name: sessionId
params.description: The unique ID of the parent AI troubleshooting session.

params.name: messageId
params.description: The unique ID of the troubleshooting message.

definition.description: A curated collection of `Equipment` documents for public display on the landing page, exposing only public-facing fields (e.g., `name`, `imageUris`, `description`). This adheres to Structural Segregation by separating public data from the main `equipment` collection's authenticated access. Publicly readable for unauthenticated users.

params.name: equipmentId
params.description: The unique ID of the equipment, referencing the original `equipment` document.
